name: SLED Smart Letters to Santa
author: Nick Scilingo (FocusedOnSound)
description: SLED (Smart Letters Express Delivery) — sensor-driven video playback, car counting, and Home Assistant integration for interactive Santa Mailbox displays. Supports GPIO letter/donation sensors, HLK-LD2410B radar car detection, MQTT/HA discovery, and SQLite-backed analytics dashboard.

privacy.summary: Logs presence/motion events from the mailbox's radar and beam-break sensors locally, and, if enabled, publishes counts to your MQTT broker. No registration, no license server.

sends.what: presence/car-count events and Home Assistant discovery config
sends.why: MQTT / Home Assistant integration (disabled by default)

collects.what: presence/motion events: letter drop, donation, car pass/parked, direction, timestamp
transient raw radar diagnostic snapshot (per-gate distance/energy) while diagnostics is open

systemChanges.what: creates and enables sled-mailbox.service (systemd), running as the fpp user
adds a sudoers rule (/etc/sudoers.d/sled-mailbox) letting fpp restart sled-mailbox.service only
writes its reserved GPIO pins into FPP's own gpio.json to avoid pin conflicts
installs adafruit-circuitpython-dht via pip from PyPI, only if DHT11 support is enabled

privacy.other: The dashboard's "Reset Today's Data" clears only the current day's events; older history persists with no automatic retention/purge unless deleted by hand.
